items.title: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空會員資料外洩逾1,177萬筆，近200個帳號的密碼遭改
items.summary: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空（Capcom）證實，旗下會員帳號服務CAPCOM ID遭第三方入侵，導致全球超過1,177萬筆會員資料外洩，其中有196個帳號的登入密碼遭擅自變更。卡普空表示，未發現會員自行設定的密碼外洩，信用卡資料也不在此次外洩範圍。 CAPCOM ID是卡普空旗下網路服務及部分線上遊戲使用的共用帳號。外洩資料包括會員電子郵件地址、帳號建立時間、最後登入時間、登入次數，以及最後登入時使用的IP位址，而有43筆還包含出生年月日、性別、國家或地區及暱稱。

items.title: 戶外用品業者歐都納接獲消費者反映疑似個資外洩，重訊指出委外平臺業者資料庫遭自動化攻擊
items.summary: 以戶外機能服飾、登山裝備及休閒用品為主要商品的興櫃公司歐都納（2940），於10月22日在公開資訊觀測站發布資安事件重大訊息，表示委外服務平臺業者的資料庫遭到自動化攻擊，部分資訊遭非法擷取，當日並接獲消費者反映疑似個資外洩。

items.title: 私鑰安全事故延燒，印度eMudhra宣布退出SSL/TLS憑證市場
items.summary: 印度數位憑證業者eMudhra週四（10/22）宣布，將退出全球SSL/TLS憑證市場。該公司日前被發現有8張中繼憑證授權機構（CA）憑證的私密金鑰存在嚴重安全問題，攻擊者可輕易還原私鑰，進而偽造網站憑證。這讓Google、蘋果、微軟及Mozilla等業者相繼封鎖有問題的中繼CA憑證，亦使得eMudhra最終決定退出憑證業務。

items.title: fix(gateway): keep channel-less agent turns channel-less after restar…
items.summary: fix(gateway): keep channel-less agent turns channel-less after restart recovery (#181420) * fix(gateway): preserve channel-less restart recovery At src/gateway/agent-turn/agent-restart-recovery-context.ts:62, an absent session delivery route incorrectly selected WebChat for an internal operator recovery turn. Require an explicit WebChat route instead, while preserving Control UI context and correlated channel delivery authority. Cover delivery planning through Gateway dispatch and embedded runtime resolution, retain real WebChat message-tool delivery, and document the channel-less recovery behavior. Subagent restart and requester-settle wakes do not enter the main-session-only fallback. Validation: the channel-less regression fails on the base with WebChat instead of undefined; all four focused test files pass (71 tests) with the fix. Changed-file oxfmt/oxlint and both targeted typecheck graphs pass. * fix(agents): preserve restart recovery source channels The agent-command claim recorded internal ingress but discarded the runtime message channel (agent-command-restart-recovery.ts:352 on base 575b49f73c2). The resolver's route-less fallback at agent-restart-recovery-context.ts:62 therefore resumed channel-less agent RPC turns as WebChat. Record the original message channel, including explicit null for channel-less turns, at command admission and record WebChat in the chat journal. Preserve that fact through claim adoption and clear it with the rest of the claim. Restore the recorded channel while retaining the route-guarded WebChat fallback for older in-flight claims. Preserve #172982's dashboard/WebChat progress sink and rejection of targetless sends on external-channel keys. The producer-to-runtime regression fails on base with webchat instead of an absent channel. Focused recovery, message-tool and prefix-stability tests cover the fix; no configuration or migration is needed. * fix(gateway): restore only channel-less recovery from the recorded source channel Recorded non-WebChat channels keep the ingress-specific restoration, including channel delivery authority.
